label: Terrain traps
compute: // Below steep ground: gullies (ground channelling inwards) and abrupt flattening,
// where an avalanche's debris piles up deep.
vec2 up = dot(g, g) > 1e-12 ? normalize(g) : vec2(0.0, 1.0);
float above = degrees(atan((elev(up * 60.0) - elev(up * 20.0)) / 40.0)); // 20-60 m upslope

presentation.footnote: Gullies and sudden flattening below steep slopes
